goal: Determine whether the candidate repository already provides the required reusable capability.
task: Inspect the implementation and produce runtime evidence before recommending reuse or custom development.
success_conditions: A source-level implementation path is identified.
A real runtime proof or an explicit evidence-backed reason why runtime proof is impossible is recorded.
stop_conditions: Stop and escalate if source evidence contradicts the README claim.
Do not recommend custom implementation before reuse has been evaluated.

procedures.title: OSS capability verification
steps: Inspect the actual implementation path, not only documentation.
Run the smallest safe executable proof.
Recommend reuse only if the verified capability satisfies the requirement.
